_note: Translation of the Japanese draft. Traditional accounts remain attributed.

chapter.title: Battle of Kawanakajima
chapter.intro: Fog blankets the Chikuma River as Takeda Shingen and Uesugi Kenshin face one another. According to legend, Kenshin descended from the mountains by night and closed in on Takeda's headquarters. Find your allies in the fog and fight your way through Kawanakajima.

長蛇.name: Long Serpent Formation
長蛇.intro: Troops march in a long single file. It suits narrow roads and valleys but leaves the flank exposed.

方円.name: Circle Formation
方円.intro: Troops form a defensive ring around their commander, ready for attacks from any direction.

鶴翼.name: Crane's Wing Formation
鶴翼.intro: Troops form a V like a crane's outstretched wings, enveloping attackers from both sides.

魚鱗.name: Fish Scale Formation
魚鱗.intro: Troops form layered triangles like fish scales, concentrating force to break the enemy line head-on.

雁行.name: Wild Geese Formation
雁行.intro: Troops march diagonally like geese in flight, ready to answer threats on the flank.

偃月.name: Crescent Moon Formation
偃月.intro: Troops form a crescent and charge behind their commander. It lifts morale while exposing the commander to danger.

総懸かり.name: Full Assault Formation
総懸かり.intro: The whole army charges together, breaking formation for one decisive assault.

鋒矢.name: Arrowhead Formation
鋒矢.intro: An arrowhead concentrates force in the vanguard to pierce a single point in the enemy line.

衡軛.name: Yoke Formation
衡軛.intro: Two staggered columns advance while supporting one another.

車懸り.name: Wheel Formation
車懸り.intro: Tradition describes troops rotating like a wheel, with fresh units taking turns at the front.

01_信玄.name: Takeda Shingen
01_信玄.line: Daimyo of Kai, famed for his Wind, Forest, Fire and Mountain banner.

02_勘助.name: Yamamoto Kansuke
02_勘助.line: Takeda strategist said to have proposed the Woodpecker plan.

03_信繁.name: Takeda Nobushige
03_信繁.line: Shingen's younger brother, killed at Kawanakajima.

04_信春.name: Baba Nobuharu
04_信春.line: A brave commander who supported the Takeda house.

05_昌信.name: Kosaka Masanobu
05_昌信.line: A senior Takeda retainer said to have led a separate detachment.

06_昌景.name: Yamagata Masakage
06_昌景.line: A Takeda commander known for his red-armored troops.

07_昌豊.name: Naito Masatoyo
07_昌豊.line: A commander who served the Takeda in government and war.

08_三条.name: Lady Sanjo
08_三条.line: Shingen's principal wife, born into the courtly Sanjo house.

09_謙信.name: Uesugi Kenshin
09_謙信.line: Daimyo of Echigo, he fought Shingen at Kawanakajima.

10_景家.name: Kakizaki Kageie
10_景家.line: He is said to have commanded the Uesugi vanguard.

11_景綱.name: Naoe Kagetsuna
11_景綱.line: A senior retainer who oversaw Uesugi affairs.

12_定満.name: Usami Sadamitsu
12_定満.line: He is remembered in tradition as a Uesugi strategist.

13_景持.name: Amakasu Kagemochi
13_景持.line: He is said to have held the rear for the Uesugi army.

14_仙桃院.name: Sentoin
14_仙桃院.line: Kenshin's elder sister, who supported the Uesugi house.

rules.falling: When you match tiles, the tiles above them drop.
rules.boss: Duel: Clear all four Kenshin tiles before clearing Shingen's four. If Shingen falls first, you lose. The duel in which a war fan caught a sword is a later legend.
rules.fog: Fog rolls in from the upper corners and covers tiles and empty spaces. You cannot select tiles in fog or route a line through fog, even around a covered edge. Each linked pair pushes the fog back toward its corner. Fog also retreats if there are no links left. Redeploy and stratagems affect only tiles outside the fog. Retreat restores it.
